summary: Northrim BanCorp filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 earnings plus a material impairment under Item 2.06. Management concluded a $20.0 million aggregate exposure to a single Northrim Funding Services borrower in the Specialty Finance segment was impaired, recording an $8.8 million charge ($6.7 million after-tax, about $0.29 per diluted share) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, citing alleged product quality-control payment disputes, weak collections, uncertain insurance recoveries, and collateral liquidation. No M&A, tender, or capital-return event; resolution expected over several quarters.
